articles.title: Russia kills 27 in 'senseless' strikes on Ukraine days before ceasefire
articles.description: Russian drone and missile attacks killed at least 27 people across Ukraine on May 5, 2026, with worst hit in Zaporizhzhia (12 killed). Ukraine's Zelenskyy condemned Russian attacks ahead of Moscow's May 8-9 unilateral ceasefire announcement.

articles.title: Ukraine counteroffensive gains territory in Oleksandrivka direction
articles.description: General Oleksandr Komarenko reported Ukrainian forces restored control over 285.6 km² in Oleksandrivka direction and cleared approximately 400 km² total since counteroffensive operations began, with February 2026 being the first month since 2024 when Ukraine regained more territory than lost.

articles.title: Ukraine strikes Russian Kinef oil refinery in Leningrad region
articles.description: Ukrainian forces attacked Russia's Kinef oil refinery in Kirishi, Leningrad region on May 5, sparking a fire in the industrial area. The strike targeted one of Russia's largest oil refineries as part of Ukraine's campaign to disrupt Russian war funding.

articles.title: Ukraine air defense neutralizes 89 of 108 Russian drones
articles.description: Ukraine's air defense forces shot down or neutralized 89 out of 108 drones launched by Russian forces in an overnight attack on May 6, demonstrating significant capability against Russian aerial assault.

articles.title: Zelensky announces new stage in Ukrainian long-range strike capabilities
articles.description: President Zelenskyy announced a new phase in Ukrainian weapons use to limit Russia's war potential, with Ukraine conducting at least 18 strikes against Russian oil infrastructure in April and striking targets over 1,600 kilometers away in the Urals.

articles.title: Russia declares ceasefire for May 8-9 around Victory Day parade
articles.description: Russia announced a ceasefire from May 8-9, 2026 to coincide with Victory Day commemoration and military parade in Moscow. Russian Defense Ministry warned of massive retaliation if Ukraine attempts to disrupt the celebration.

articles.title: Russian forces conduct 186 combat clashes on May 5 frontline
articles.description: Over May 5, 2026, Russian forces conducted 186 combat engagements across the frontline, with reported attacks involving ballistic missiles, airstrikes, and drone operations targeting multiple Ukrainian regions.

articles.title: Russian drone attack kills 5 civilians in Crimea city of Dzhankoi
articles.description: Sergei Aksyonov reported that Ukrainian drone attacks killed five civilians in the Russian-occupied Crimean city of Dzhankoi on May 5, 2026.

articles.title: Russian casualties reach 1,337,170 personnel as of May 6
articles.description: Ukrainian officials report total Russian combat losses from February 24, 2022 to May 6, 2026 amount to approximately 1,337,170 personnel, with 970 reported losses over the past 24 hours.

articles.title: Russian airstrikes hit Zaporizhzhia killing 12, injuring 37
articles.description: Russian glide bomb attacks on Zaporizhzhia on May 5 killed at least 12 people and injured 37 others, hitting a car repair shop and residential buildings in one of the worst attacks on the city this year.
